segments.title: 第109章 親親舒服嗎?
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 109: Does Kissing Feel Good?

Reaching the end of a chapter, Li Luo thought for a moment and left a hook for the subsequent plot, introduced through character dialogue to keep the readers in suspense.

Commonly known as a cliffhanger.

Once he was done, Li Luo quickly scanned the chapter's content. Seeing no major issues, he nodded in satisfaction.

Just then, his phone rang.

The caller ID showed an unknown number.

Li Luo remembered what his editor had said and picked up the phone.

"Hello? Hi." The voice on the other end sounded like an older man. "Are you Li Luo? Your pen name is Reignited."

"I am."

"I'm a staff member from the Online Writers' Association. You were recommended by Qidian and have recently been successfully accepted," the person on the other end said. "When do you think you'll have time to come to the association and pick up your writer's certificate?"

"Do I need to make an appointment for that?"

"No, you don't." The person said, "You can come any time during working hours."

"If I don't go for a while, will my qualification be revoked?"

"...You are actually already a member of the association, but you need to come in person to register," the person said. "If you're really too busy recently, just save my number. When you have time, just let me know."

"Okay, thank you."

On weekdays, Li Luo had to go to school.

As for the weekend, he wasn't sure if a place like the Writers' Association would be open.

If it didn't affect his membership status, then Li Luo wasn't in a hurry.

Regarding that writer's certificate, in his past life, Li Luo had written a book with one to two thousand average subscriptions and was able to scrape by into the municipal Online Writers' Association.

Simply getting a writer's certificate was useless, other than to show off at home. Plus, you had to pay an annual membership fee of over two hundred yuan.

The association required members to register in person. To put it nicely, it was to pick up the writer's certificate, but in reality, it was to collect some membership fees...

Otherwise, for something that could be done with a simple registration, the personal information had already been submitted clearly. Why would they need someone to make an extra trip in person?

While Li Luo was talking with the staff member from the Writers' Association, Yan Zhusheng, who was beside him, saw that he had finished writing and curiously glanced at the computer screen.

But after a few glances at the main text, she was completely stumped.

Why did she feel like she couldn't understand the plot?

She looked at the chapter title again.

Chapter 325?

Yan Zhusheng blinked, took out her phone from her pocket, and checked *I'm Really Not a Star*.

Chapter 225...

Yan Zhusheng froze. She flipped back and forth on the book's page on her phone but couldn't find any subsequent chapters.

For a moment, she thought her phone was lagging.

But after clicking into Chapter 225 and taking a look, she was certain that this was indeed as far as she had read today.

There was nothing after it.

In other words...

Yan Zhusheng glanced at Li Luo, who was still on the phone, and quietly extended her small hand, scrolling the mouse wheel a few times.

Soon, she saw Chapter 324, Chapter 323, Chapter 322...

This... there was a stockpile of a hundred full chapters?!

Even with Yan Zhusheng's disposition, a trace of shock appeared in her eyes.

But immediately after, she felt an itch in her heart.

Looking at the full hundred chapters stockpiled in the computer, her eyes narrowed slightly, like a greedy little cat wanting to sneak a snack.

But just then, Li Luo finished his call. Noticing Yan Zhusheng's small movements, he immediately grabbed her by the wrist. "No peeking."

"I wasn't peeking," Yan Zhusheng said. "I was looking directly."

"That's not allowed either." Li Luo took the mouse and closed the writing window. "I'm done here. Let's get ready for school."

"How much more of the plot involves Mo Qinghan?" Yan Zhusheng refused to leave, blinking as she looked at Li Luo and asked seriously.

"As the author, it is my professional ethics not to give spoilers."

"But you've already written it." Yan Zhusheng looked at the computer screen with longing. "I can help you check for typos."

"I wouldn't dare trouble you." The corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. "It's updated every day anyway. If you read too much at once, you'll have to stay up late again."

Yan Zhusheng let out a rare, soft sigh, a seldom-seen dip in her emotions, and slowly stood up to walk out.

But halfway there, she couldn't help but turn her head and ask, "Yesterday's chapter was great, but does kissing really feel that good?"

Li Luo: "..."

His face darkening, Li Luo quickly got up, pushed Yan Zhusheng towards the door, and then warned, "From now on, you're not allowed to discuss the book with me in private."

It was so damn embarrassing.

He had indeed written all sorts of detailed descriptions of the male lead and Mo Qinghan kissing in the book. He had been quite high on it while writing, so much so that he was hard all over.

But the thought of the female lead's prototype asking him to his face if kissing really felt that good was just too awkward.

Right now, Li Luo wished he could find a hole to crawl into.

"Senior, time for school!"

Arriving in the living room and grabbing his school bag, Li Luo shouted towards Xu Youyu's bedroom.

"Coming!"

Xu Youyu answered, finally snapping out of the joy of re-reading Li Luo's long review. She hurriedly shut down her computer, came out of her bedroom, and grabbed her own school bag.

While changing her shoes to leave, Xu Youyu even gave Li Luo a special glance, seemingly in a very good mood.

The three of them left together, heading for No. 1 Affiliated High School.

Meanwhile, in the classroom of Class Eight, evening self-study hadn't started yet, and many students were chatting.

A few girls were gathered in Zhu Huiyan's corner, letting out bursts of laughter from time to time.

"You guys have no idea, to banter with Yan Zhusheng, the class president even said he could get into the top 40 in the whole school," Zhu Huiyan said mysteriously. "And then Yan Zhusheng said she believed him and bet that he could definitely get into the top 40. I was stunned when I heard that."

"The class president usually seems so reliable. Does he also get this dramatic when he's in a relationship? I feel like all boys are the same."

"But I kind of feel like it's sweet, haha. Huiyan, if you keep talking, I'm about to start shipping them."

"But what if the class president really does score in the top 40 in the school?"

"How is that possible? Even Lu Jiahao and Shi Yanran can't get in, alright."

"Is the level of Class One something a parallel class can even aspire to?"

"From the entrance exam at the start of the semester, I don't think I've heard of anyone from a parallel class getting into the top 40. The highest were only in the fifties or sixties, like Lu Jiahao from our class."

"Then if the class president gets into the top 40, wouldn't he be the first person from a parallel class to do so?"

"Haha! No way, that's way too hard."

Just as they were happily chatting, Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng walked in through the back door of the classroom.

The moment they saw the two, the circle of girls immediately scattered like frightened birds, each returning to their seats.

Although Yan Zhusheng had integrated into the class a little more thanks to Li Luo's efforts, the undercurrent of gossip was still hard to reduce.

However, the pure animosity towards Yan Zhusheng had clearly lessened, and some people had even started to ship them.

Completely unaware of this, Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng put down their school bags. Li Luo then found Hua Xiuxiu and told her his plans for the evening self-study session, asking her to manage the class for a while.

Afterward, before the bell for evening self-study rang, Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng left the classroom together and headed for the Rock Club's activity room on the second floor of the gymnasium.

After the evening self-study session began, someone soon noticed that two people were missing from the back row.

The girls who had been discussing Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng earlier exchanged glances, as if they had discovered another secret.

"They're that bold?"

"Sneaking out for a tryst during evening self-study?"

Gossip like this began to spread quietly among the girls.

(End of this chapter)
